recipe_version.title: Miso Mushroom Ramen
recipe_version.description: Springy ramen noodles in a dried-shiitake broth enriched with white miso, tahini, garlic, and ginger, topped with soy-seared shiitake, tender baby bok choy, sweet corn, nori, scallions, and sesame. Fully plant-based: no egg, no bonito, no pork or chicken broth, no butter.

ingredients.name: dried shiitake mushrooms
ingredients.note: about 3/4 oz (20 g) whole dried caps; the broth base. Plant broth only: no bonito, no pork or chicken stock.
ingredients.preparation: rinsed briefly, soaked in the broth water

ingredients.name: fresh shiitake mushrooms
ingredients.preparation: stems removed, caps sliced 1/4 inch thick

ingredients.name: white miso
ingredients.note: about 4.5 oz. REQUIRED plant contract: plain miso paste (soybeans, rice or barley koji, salt). Do not use dashi-iri / 'with dashi' / bonito-added miso or instant miso-soup mix. Soy allergen; barley miso also contains gluten (wheat already declared).

ingredients.name: tahini
ingredients.note: well stirred; adds body to the broth. Sesame allergen. Not a nut.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp in the miso tare, 1 tbsp for the mushrooms. Regular brewed soy sauce: soy and wheat.

ingredients.name: toasted sesame oil
ingredients.note: 2 tsp for the aromatics, 1 tsp to finish. Sesame allergen.

ingredients.name: ramen noodles
ingredients.note: 12 oz dried or about 1.25 lb fresh. REQUIRED contract: label lists wheat flour, water, salt, and alkaline salts (kansui) with no egg. If using instant-noodle blocks, discard the seasoning packet (often contains milk, fish, or meat).

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.note: whites for the aromatics, greens to finish
ingredients.preparation: thinly sliced, whites and greens separated

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: broth water (hot tap water is fine for the soak). Noodle cooking water is separate and not listed.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: a pinch for the mushrooms; more only after tasting the finished broth

steps.title: Soak the dried shiitake and prep
steps.body: Rinse the dried shiitake and drop them into 8 cups of hot tap water in a large bowl or pitcher to soak while you prep (they soften and start the broth). Fill a separate large pot with water for the noodles, cover, and set it over high heat. Remove the fresh shiitake stems and slice the caps 1/4 inch thick. Halve and rinse the bok choy. Thaw the corn in a sieve under warm water. Grate the garlic and ginger. Slice the scallions, keeping whites and greens separate. Cut the nori into 8 rectangles. In a small bowl stir the miso, tahini, and 2 tbsp soy sauce into a smooth paste (the tare). HARD CONTRACT: plain miso (no bonito/dashi added), egg-free noodles, no butter, no egg topping, no pork or chicken broth.

steps.title: Sear the mushrooms
steps.body: Heat the neutral oil in a 5- to 6-quart pot over medium-high. Add the sliced fresh shiitake in an even layer with a pinch of salt and cook undisturbed 3 minutes, then stir occasionally until browned with crisp edges, 3 to 4 minutes more. Add 1 tbsp soy sauce and toss 30 seconds until absorbed and glossy. Transfer to a plate; this is the topping.

steps.title: Build the broth
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium. Add 2 tsp toasted sesame oil, the garlic, ginger, and scallion whites; stir 1 minute until fragrant without browning. Pour in the soaked dried shiitake and their soaking water, leaving any grit in the bottom of the bowl. Bring to a simmer over high, about 8 minutes, then reduce to a gentle simmer, partly covered, for 8 minutes. Lift out the rehydrated shiitake, slice thinly, and return them to the pot.

steps.title: Cook the bok choy, corn, and noodles
steps.body: Add the bok choy and corn to the simmering broth and cook until the bok choy stems are crisp-tender, 2 to 3 minutes; lift the bok choy out with tongs. At the same time, cook the noodles in the boiling noodle pot according to the package (fresh about 2 to 3 minutes, dried about 4 to 5) until just tender; drain well and shake dry. Do not rinse.

steps.title: Season the broth
steps.body: Turn the broth to low; it should not boil from here on. Ladle about 1 cup hot broth into the miso-tahini tare, whisk smooth, and stir it back into the pot. Taste; add a pinch of salt only if needed.

steps.title: Assemble the bowls
steps.body: Divide the noodles among 4 deep bowls and ladle about 1 1/2 cups broth with corn and sliced shiitake over each. Arrange the seared shiitake and two bok choy halves on top, tuck 2 nori rectangles at the rim, and finish with scallion greens, sesame seeds, and a few drops of the remaining 1 tsp toasted sesame oil. Serve immediately. No egg, no butter, no chashu. kitchen_tested is false.

equipment: large bowl or pitcher for soaking
recipe_version.heat: Medium-high sear, then simmer; broth held below a boil after the miso goes in.
recipe_version.doneness: Mushrooms browned with crisp edges. Bok choy stems crisp-tender and bright. Noodles springy, not soft. Broth opaque, savory, and creamy-bodied from miso and tahini, not boiled after seasoning. kitchen_tested is false.

dietary_eligibility.nut_policy_note: No peanuts, tree nuts, or cashews. Tahini and sesame are sesame allergen tokens, not nuts.
dietary_eligibility.hh001_reason: Plant miso ramen. No dairy (no butter or corn-butter), no shellfish, no meat, no poultry, no pork or chicken broth, no bonito (plant claim chosen even though HH001 would allow fish), no egg topping. Miso and noodles are contracted plain/egg-free. Soy, wheat, and sesame present; HH001 allows them. Nuts absent.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Unconditional dairy_free, vegetarian, and plant_based. Hard contracts: plain miso without bonito/dashi, egg-free ramen noodles, instant seasoning packets discarded, no egg, no butter. Not an 'add an egg if you like' recipe.
allergen_notes: Soy covers miso and soy sauce.
Wheat covers the ramen noodles and regular brewed soy sauce (and barley-koji miso, if used, contains gluten).
Sesame covers tahini, toasted sesame oil, and sesame seeds.
No egg (egg-free noodle contract, no soft-boiled egg), no milk (no butter), no peanut, tree_nut, shellfish, or finfish (no bonito).
